verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD, and Gitea ships an official action runner you deploy yourself. Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners are also listed, so running pipelines on your own private runners is supported. The evidence does not show platform-hosted runners: the managed offering is described only as a managed Gitea environment, and nothing mentions a centralized runner or pipeline visibility dashboard. Missing for 10: documented platform-hosted runners, centralized visibility/management of runners and pipeline runs, detailed runner docs, and hands-on corroboration of Actions runners.
